name: 9487-batchdecode-qwen25vl3b-1gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct -- public and ungated, ~7 GB downloaded on first launch
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one node, no router and no external cache tier
architecture: Qwen2_5_VLForConditionalGeneration -- 36-layer bf16 language model (16 query heads over 2 KV heads, head_size 128, hidden 2048) plus a 32-layer vision tower
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), 16 streams, warmup the first 20%, bounded at 320 requests with a 1200 s safety cap
workload: Single-turn text chat against a vision-language checkpoint: about 64 prompt tokens in, exactly 1024 tokens out, `ignore_eos` so the run length is the declared one. No images and no image dataset.
purpose: A text-only creative writing assistant on a 3B vision-capable model, sixteen concurrent users, brief prompts, thousand-token replies, one GPU.
launch:
# Flat `key: value` only -- a nested block is dropped by the flat parser.
# host, port and served-model-name are supplied at launch and must not be declared here.

model-path: Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct
tp-size: 1
